correctness.rationale: Under perfect off-origin relocation, an indicator of being at the origin next step has exact conditional probability q_n=C_n/(n+1)(1-pJ_n), p=1-xi_0. Hence a_n=C_n/(n+1) is a bounded nonnegative supermartingale with drift -p a_nJ_n/(n+2). Summability plus a hypothetical a_infty>0 contradicts harmonic divergence, giving a_n→0. The log C increment has predictable drift (1-pJ_n)/(n+1)+O(1/[(n+1)C_n]); its martingale controls first polynomial C_n growth, then C_n=n^(1-o(1)) a.s., yielding eventually C_n>=n^(3/4). Exact drift of Q_n=(n+1)/C_n is pJ_n/C_n+r_n with r_n <=C_n^(-2); conditional variance <=4(n+1)/C_n³. Both summable, so Q_n -p Σ_(k<n)J_k/C_k converges a.s. The harmonic identity Σ_(k<n)J_k/C_k=H_(C_n)-J_n/C_n yields Q_n-p log C_n→L and inversion gives -p loglog n correction and C_n log n/n→1/p. Independent exact rational derivation checked 4680 (t,c,J,p) drift configurations. Requires xi_0 in (0,1), off-origin relocation exactly one and origin start; no claim on L law or nondegeneracy.
